Name: Pets' Quality of Life
Author: Minakie
TagLine: This mod slightly improves the lives of the farm pets and Dusty by giving them food alongside their water. It also gives Dusty a rubber ball to play with.
Description:
__<s>![](https://i.postimg.cc/zXgDX0nc/about-the-mod.png) </s>__
**_This mod is still compatible with the 1.5 update!_**
[Coolwyngs](http://community.playstarbound.com/members/coolwyngs.627316/)asked me to share my water/food bowl and I decided to take the chance to make this mod.

This mod turns the farm pet's water bowl and Dusty's water bow into a water/food bowl so that they don't starve to death. It also gives Dusty a proper dog house instead of an old cardboard box, a rubber ball to play with and a fancier Dog sign.

"__This mod is still relevant to 1.4, the event that improves Dusty's pen doesn't even trigger till year 3. Until then this can give the pup food and water.__" ~[HannaVictoria](https://www.nexusmods.com/users/65233136)

![](https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/932/932-1576437043-574760047.png)
You can choose between a yellow or a red dog house.
You can add optional seasonal add-ons (flower, fruit, leaf).

 ![](https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/932/932-1576437065-1918456314.png)

Each of the 4 elements of this mod (farm bowl, Dusty bowl, Dusty house, dog sign) can be turned on/off at will in the config file, to prevent incompatibility issues with other mods that may change the same elements.

_**_![](https://i.postimg.cc/d0qJ6Fgb/installation.png) _**
_
- Make sure you have [SMAPI](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400)and [Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915)installed as well
- Download my latest file and unzip it
- Navigate to your "__Stardew Valley\Mods"__folder and drop the extracted folder there
- Run the game to generate the config file (just leave it as-is or tweak the options to your liking)
- Have fun :)

Downloads.Description: Adds a red option for Dusty's house, as well as optional seasonal add-ons (flower, fruit, leaf) for it.
